guion_largo.texto:
This is a walk. There is no need to stop. Follow the signs toward the Plaza of the Stela of the Two Glyphs and let the audio keep you company.

As you move forward, look at the terraces and stone walls around you. Kenneth Hirth explains that people lived on large terraces and platforms on the slopes, and that the houses spread toward the valley floor. What you see as landscape was a neighborhood.

The paved causeways connected the sectors of the city. They were not an ornament. They carried people, goods and news from one neighborhood to another.

If the path climbs, think that whoever lived here climbed it every day, with a load or without one. In a city of hills, walking was part of the work.

When you reach a wide plaza, with a stela at the center, you are already at the next audio.
